PORT.description: Pinned to the port the public domain targets. Railway injects 8080 otherwise and the healthcheck drifts off the real listener.

RAKAZO_HOST.description: The web server only answers requests for this hostname (vite allowedHosts). It is the public domain and never needs changing.

DATABASE_URL.description: Wired to the Postgres service in this template.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts the provider keys and bot secrets people add inside the app. Generated for you. Changing it makes every stored key permanently unreadable, so leave it alone.

SIGNUPS_ENABLED.description: The first registered user becomes the deployment owner. Set to false after registering to close the instance.

SANDBOX_PROVIDER.description: Where bot computers run: none, e2b, daytona or box. Docker is not possible on Railway, so the default is none: bots chat and use tools but cannot open a desktop. Pick a provider and fill in its API key below to enable computers. Safe to change later with a redeploy.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Signs everyone's sessions. Generated for you. Changing it signs everybody out; it loses no data.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Deployment-wide fallback model key. Optional: a model can also be connected in the UI after signup, where the app verifies the key before storing it. Every model call is billed to the key you provide.

SCREEN_PROXY_SECRET.description: Guards the noVNC screen proxy used when bots have computers. Generated for you. Unused while SANDBOX_PROVIDER is none.

PGDATA.description: Where the database is initialized. A subdirectory of the mount, because a volume root is never empty and initdb refuses a non-empty directory.
